clinical_target.event_scored_population: readings currently at or below the threshold
clinical_target.prediction_interval: 80 percent, quantile regression at 0.10 and 0.90, widened by conformal calibration on validation patients

evaluation_protocol: Primary: patient level holdout, test patients unseen in training and threshold selection. Secondary: chronological holdout on the final 3 days of the training patients. The operating threshold comes from validation patients only.
